holidays.name: National Coming Out Day
holidays.description: A day when people celebrate LGBTQ+ identities and the courage it takes to live openly and authentically, with events, parades, and plenty of rainbow-colored joy.
holidays.origin: Founded in 1988 by Robert Eichberg and Jean O'Leary, marking the first anniversary of the 1987 National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights.
holidays.funFact: The day is now observed in several countries, including the United States, the UK, Canada, and Switzerland.

holidays.name: International Day of the Girl Child
holidays.description: A United Nations day dedicated to highlighting girls' rights, education, and the challenges girls face worldwide, while celebrating their power and potential.
holidays.origin: The UN General Assembly adopted a resolution establishing it in December 2011, and the first observance took place on October 11, 2012.
holidays.funFact: Landmarks around the world are lit up in pink each year to mark the occasion.

holidays.name: National Sausage Pizza Day
holidays.description: A day to honor the glorious union of crispy crust, melted cheese, and savory sausage crumbles. Pizza purists and sausage lovers can finally agree on something.
holidays.origin: Like many food holidays, it grew out of pizza enthusiasts and food marketers in the internet era, with no single official founder.
holidays.funFact: Sausage is consistently one of the most popular pizza toppings in the United States, rivaled only by pepperoni.

holidays.name: Southern Food Heritage Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the rich culinary traditions of the American South, from fried chicken and biscuits to collard greens, grits, and pecan pie.
holidays.origin: Promoted by Southern food enthusiasts and heritage groups as a way to honor regional cooking traditions and the cultural history behind them.
holidays.funFact: Many classic Southern dishes, such as okra stew and black-eyed peas, trace their roots to West African cooking traditions.

holidays.name: It's My Party Day
holidays.description: A day for throwing yourself a party just because you feel like it. No birthday, promotion, or milestone is required, just snacks, music, and good vibes.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance that encourages people to celebrate themselves and their own accomplishments, big or small.
holidays.funFact: The name nods to the 1963 Lesley Gore hit 'It's My Party,' which reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 when Gore was just 17.
